title: event
description: One line of the event log (.harness/events.jsonl), one branch per kind. A human and tool mirror of the loader's exact key set per kind; the crate does not interpret this file, and a test pins each branch's required set to the loader's. A line is at most 4096 bytes including its newline.

oneOf.title: escalation
oneOf.description: A fix-round cap was reached and the ticket was escalated.

v.description: Schema version. A reader refuses any other value (a v1 line is never upgraded).

run_id.description: The identity of the run that wrote this event; self-issued or inherited, never guessed.

role.description: The role of the run that wrote this event; never defaulted.

model.description: The model of the run that wrote this event; never defaulted.
